title: The Interview: Secrets of the Efik kitchen

claims.ekpang: Ekpang Nkukwo is an Efik pottage of cocoyam, a dish the article calls a labour of love.
claims.abakAtama: Abak Atama is an Efik soup made from boiled, pounded oil-palm fruit and flavoured with uyayak and atama.
claims.fishermanSoup: Fisherman's Soup is a well-known Efik soup; the article says it began with fishermen who were away for weeks and cooked with basic provisions and what they caught.
claims.edikang: Edikang Ikong is called the king of Efik soups and uses waterleaf and fluted pumpkin leaves.
